Posted April 16, 2002

American medical cannabis refugees, Libertarian activist Steve Kubby and Steve Tuck, a severely disabled veteran, have been taken into custody by the RCMP. This action, supposedly related to their immigration status in Canada, follows several media reports about medical cannabis refugees in British Columbia. Both are represented by excellent Canadian attorneys, but they are being held in detention under conditions that put their lives at risk.

I will post daily updates on their cases.
